---
title: "Feature Categories"
format: html
---


Higher scores on these features are risks unless otherwise noted at protective.  Feature names are aligned with direction that feature is scored.

1.  Time at locations with alcohol

2.  Time at locations to avoid

3.  Time at locations with past drinking

4.  Locations with mixed emotions 

5.  Time at locations with pleasant emotions (protective)

6.  Time at locations with unpleasant emotions (protective)

7.  Time at locations that are risky

8.  Time at locations with AA (protective)

9.  Time at locations with friends (protective)

10. Time at locations with Healthcare (protective)

11. Time at home (protective)

12. Time at restaurants

13. Time at work

14. Self-report of LOW future efficacy/motivation (NOTE: High scores on item 10 from survey mean LOW motivation/efficacy) 

15. Self-report of abstinence goal

16. Self-report of craving

17. Self-report of past risky situations

18. Self-report of future risky situations

19. Self-report of past stressors or hassles

20. Self-report of future stressors or hassles

21. Self-report of pleasant events (protective)

22. Self-report of past use

23. Self-report of activated negative affect (e.g., high scores: angry, low scores: relaxed)

24. Self-report of activated positive affect (protective;  e.g., high scores:elated, low scores: depressed)

25. Time in evenings out of home

26. Day of week (i.e., weekends are risk)

27. Location variance (risk)
